Senior Backend Engineer, Platform APIs

Location: New York, United States office (hybrid). Compensation is discussed at offer stage.

Tessellate builds a scheduling platform used by mid-sized manufacturers. You will design and evolve the public APIs that customers integrate with, and own the services behind them in production.

What you will do: design versioned REST and event APIs; build and operate Go services on PostgreSQL; join the on-call rotation for the services you own; improve observability and runbooks.

What you bring (essential): several years designing and operating backend services and public APIs; production operations experience.

Nice to have: PostgreSQL performance tuning; event streaming.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.
